title: Lehigh vs Northeastern: tuition, size, location
summary: Lehigh University (Lehigh) versus Northeastern University Oakland (Northeastern). Also searched as Northeastern vs Lehigh. Scorecard table is sourced; prose is checked against those facts. UniRepository is not affiliated with either school.

sections.heading: How they differ
paragraphs: Lehigh University and Northeastern University Oakland are both private nonprofit institutions, as indicated by their ownership codes reported by College Scorecard. Lehigh University, located in Bethlehem, has a significantly larger undergraduate enrollment of 5,898 students compared to Northeastern University Oakland's 464. Tuition costs also differ, with Lehigh charging $64,980 for in-state students, while Northeastern's tuition is slightly higher at $67,778. These distinctions highlight differences in size, location, and cost between Lehigh University vs Northeastern University Oakland, or simply Lehigh vs Northeastern.

sections.heading: Cost
paragraphs: When comparing the cost of attendance between Lehigh University and Northeastern University Oakland, Lehigh charges $64,980 for both in-state and out-of-state tuition. Northeastern University Oakland's tuition is slightly higher, at $67,778 for both in-state and out-of-state students. Regarding student debt, the median debt for completers at Lehigh University is $21,960, whereas at Northeastern University Oakland, it is $24,250. These figures provide insight into the financial commitments associated with attending each institution, reflecting differences in tuition rates and typical student borrowing between Lehigh vs Northeastern.

paragraphs: Lehigh University and Northeastern University Oakland differ notably in their learning environments and campus settings. In contrast, Northeastern University Oakland, located in Oakland, California, has a smaller undergraduate enrollment of 464 students, which may contribute to a more intimate learning atmosphere. These distinctions in size and location reflect varied campus experiences between Lehigh University vs Northeastern University Oakland, or Lehigh vs Northeastern.

sections.heading: Pick Lehigh if
paragraphs: Pick Lehigh if you are seeking a private nonprofit university with a moderately selective admission rate of approximately 26%. The institution charges $64,980 for tuition, applicable to both in-state and out-of-state students. Lehigh University demonstrates a strong commitment to student success, as reflected in its high completion rate of nearly 88% within 150% of the expected time to graduate. These factors make Lehigh a compelling choice for students prioritizing academic rigor and degree completion.

sections.heading: Pick Northeastern if
paragraphs: Pick Northeastern if you are looking for a private nonprofit university with a highly selective admission rate of 16.65%. The tuition cost is $67,778 for both in-state and out-of-state students. Completion rate data within 150% of the expected time to graduate is not available for this institution. These factors may appeal to students prioritizing selectivity and are prepared for the associated tuition expense.
